text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 12, "unit": "miles", "kind": "count", "span": "12-mile trail"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 1, "unit": "hour", "kind": "count", "span": "1 hour to walk the first 4 miles"}, {"id": "q3", "value": 4, "unit": "miles", "kind": "count", "span": "first 4 miles"}, {"id": "q4", "value": 1, "unit": "hour", "kind": "count", "span": "another hour to walk the next two miles"}, {"id": "q5", "value": 2, "unit": "miles", "kind": "count", "span": "next two miles"}, {"id": "q6", "value": 4, "unit": "mph", "kind": "count", "span": "average speed to be 4 miles per hour"}], "plan": [{"op": "div", "args": ["q1", "q6"], "out": "s1", "note": "total time allowed for the whole trail at the target average speed"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q2", "q4"], "out": "s2", "note": "time already spent on the first two legs"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["s1", "s2"], "out": "s3", "note": "time remaining for the rest of the trail"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["q3", "q5"], "out": "s4", "note": "distance already covered"}, {"op": "sub", "args": ["q1", "s4"], "out": "s5", "note": "distance remaining"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["s5", "s3"], "out": "s6", "note": "speed needed to cover the remaining distance in the remaining time"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "speed (mph) needed for the remaining distance"}, "dismissed": []}
